title: download_user_file scans every message of every loaded history to find a file's origin
trigger: Retry/download a file with no known origin (picker sticker) with big histories loaded
effect: Linear scan over all histories on the UI thread per call
fix: Index file_id -> (chat,message) at insert time

title: Messages marked watched while the pack loads never play if the pack load fails
trigger: An incoming lone emoji is read before the EmojiAnimations pack arrives and searchStickerSet fails
effect: autoplay_emoji_effects calls mark_watched(key) before wait(); failed() clears the waiting queue, so those messages are already watched and never play their effect this session, even after the two hour retry loads the pack
fix: Mark watched only when the effect is queued, or keep waiting messages across a failed attempt

title: Two quick set switches can leave the saved choice different from the drawn set
trigger: Click Noto then Twemoji (both downloaded) within one frame
effect: switch_emoji_set stores each switch in the single switch_task slot; the older task is dropped but its background load_state + save_current(Noto) can still run after save_current(Twemoji), so 'current' on disk is Noto while Twemoji is drawn; next launch shows the other set
fix: Serialize the switch: one SwitchStage enum with the target set; apply only the latest and save on the UI side after applying

title: Two installs of the same emoji set share one temp folder and one .old folder, so overlapping installs corrupt each other
trigger: Start downloading set X, press Download X again (the first download is cancelled but its worker is already inside unpack), or run 'Install from file' for X while a download of X is finishing.
effect: Both unpack calls use '.<name>.<pid>.part' and '.<name>.old': one remove_dir_all wipes the other's half-extracted files, so the install fails with 'damaged'/'Couldn't save' or the .old rollback restores the wrong pack.
fix: Name the temp folder with a per-call serial (as copy::part_path does) or serialise installs per EmojiSetId.

title: Swipe indicator shows 'reached' after backing off slightly, but releasing does not step
trigger: Trackpad swipe past the threshold so the arrow is fully in, then pull back 1 to 2 px (ratio 0.96..0.99) and let go.
effect: pull_to keeps `reached` true until ratio drops under 0.95 (indicator() draws the armed arrow), but end() steps only when ratio() >= 1.0, so the arrow says 'let go to move' and nothing moves.
fix: Decide the step from the same armed value the indicator shows (end() uses pull.reached), or drop the stored bool and derive both from one function.

title: Shuffle Previous/Next can return a message id that is no longer in the playlist
trigger: Shuffle music, skip a few tracks, delete one of the played messages, press Previous
effect: shuffled() returns played[cursor] without checking it is still in ids; the player is asked to start a missing message
fix: Filter played against ids before using the cursor (or drop vanished ids and re-seat the cursor).

title: cancel_untracked leaves a Cancelled intent that only an idle update clears
trigger: Cancel a row for a transfer TDLib reports as paused or already idle (another device).
effect: Phase::Cancelled stays until confirm_cancel, which runs only on an active-to-idle update that never comes; is_cancelling stays true and the entry keeps its place in the indexes.
fix: Have cancel_untracked settle at once when the file is not active in FileMap.

title: Stacked optimistic reactions on one message restore the wrong snapshot when the first is refused
trigger: React with A then quickly B on the same message; set_own_reaction_for records `before` for each. A is refused: settle_own_reaction restores A's pre-image, which also removes B's optimistic reaction.
effect: B's chip disappears until TDLib's updateMessageInteractionInfo for B arrives (self-corrects); if B's request also failed, its snapshot is restored later over newer state.
fix: Undo by reverting only this request's own change (remove the reaction it added) instead of restoring a whole interaction_info snapshot.

title: Profile tabs (Stories, Gifts) accept pages from a closed and reopened gallery
trigger: Open the Gifts tab of a chat, scroll so a second page (append) is in flight, close the gallery and reopen it for the same chat before the page lands.
effect: Profile tabs are matched by open + chat_id only, never by the tab generation that open_for_tab restamps, so the old append page is added to the fresh tab: page-2 gifts show alone before the first page, or are duplicated after it, and next_offset comes from the stale page.
fix: Stamp GetProfileGifts / GetChatPostedToChatPageStories with the tab's generation (begin_profile_fetch restamps, begin_profile_more keeps it) and accept only matching answers, as the message tabs do.

title: A frame ThorVG fails to draw is asked for again on every tick
trigger: A TGS sticker whose frames ThorVG cannot render (render returns an error for some frame) is on screen.
effect: frame() delivers nothing and leaves the clip Ready; the view keeps wanting that frame, so the worker retries the failing render on every UI tick while the view waits on a frame that never comes.
fix: Turn a failed draw into ClipState::Failed (or a per-frame failed mark) so views rest and the frame is not asked again.

title: Test position_follows_the_frames_the_device_consumed sleeps 300 ms on the wall clock
trigger: cargo test
effect: Violates the deterministic-tests rule (no sleeps); slows the suite
fix: Drop the sleep; the frame-count assertion already shows no time-based advance, or use the engine's manual clock.

title: Idle watch thread spawned with std::thread::Builder, not spawn_guarded (panic-safety rule 11); a panic in look leaves watched=true forever
trigger: Any panic inside look() on the quill-audio-idle thread
effect: No new watch is ever started, so the output device is never closed after silence (keeps the Mac from idle sleep) and a stale device is only noticed by the next open
fix: Spawn through quill::thread_guard::spawn_guarded and clear `watched` in a drop guard, as Reopened does for `opening`.

title: Seek slider events are not matched to the track whose slider sent them
trigger: Start dragging the row's seek slider, then switch tracks (media key Next, or another row) before releasing.
effect: The subscription made in begin_track_playback is detached and never checks which slider fired. The old slider entity is held by the element during the drag, so its Release calls seek_active_to with the old value on the new track and moves it to a wrong position.
fix: Compare the event's entity to self.playback.seek_slider (or keep the subscription in the ActiveTrack so it drops with it) before applying.

title: Tapping the same custom emoji again while its card shows does not restart the 6 s timer
trigger: Tap emoji X, wait 5 s, tap X again.
effect: custom_emoji_card_seen already equals the preview, so no new timer is spawned; the first timer clears the card 1 s later. Likewise the timer of one window clears the session-wide preview for another window showing it.
fix: Give each tap a token in the card state and compare it in the timer.

title: Demo setup uses assert! (panics) in the downloads and voice demos
trigger: Run --screenshot-demo ready-downloads or ready-voice when the playback intent logic regresses
effect: Process panics at demo start; only reachable in the screenshot demo build (lines 205, 208, 331, 336)
fix: Return an error/log note instead of assert!, or move the checks into tests.

title: sets_asked is set before the installed-sets request and never cleared on failure
trigger: Premium user with an empty installed list; the first suggestion bar build sends while the client is not ready, or the list request errors
effect: sets_asked flips to true before ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets and its Result is dropped, so the installed list is not asked for again on this account: custom emoji never appear in the suggestion bar until the emoji box or panel loads the list
fix: Use the session's Fetch state for the installed emoji sets (idle/loading/ready/failed) and ask only from idle or failed.

title: EmojiBarUi::sets_asked is set before the installed emoji set list request is sent and stays set when it is not sent
trigger: Premium user: the ':' suggestion builds while self.live is None or ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets fails to send (send_json error). The flag is set by mem::replace before the send; later queries pass list=false.
effect: The installed emoji sets are never listed for this composer, so custom emoji never appear in the suggestion bar until the composer UI is rebuilt (account switch / new window).
fix: Drop the UI flag and let the driver key the ask on its own request state (has_purpose / installed_loaded), or set it only on a successful send.

title: Emoji effects and anchors are thread-locals keyed by chat id only, not by account
trigger: Tap a big emoji in a chat with user U on account A, switch within 2 s to account B where chat id U is also shown
effect: ACTIVE keeps A's effect (retain keeps it when its chat id is shown) and B's window can play it over B's message with the same ids; ANCHORS entries of other chats also survive the switch
fix: Key by OfAccount<ChatMessage> and clear both on the OnScreen swap (Farewell), or move them into OnScreen.

title: A pending emoji effect gets its START_WAIT clock when a window takes it, not when it arrived, so taps queued while locked play late
trigger: Open a 1:1 chat, lock Quill; the partner taps the big emoji several times; unlock. The locked window never runs emoji_effect_overlay, so the session's pending queue (up to MAX_PENDING) waits.
effect: At the unlock the old effects start (queued = now) if the emoji's anchor is still noted, and 'watching' is sent for taps long past (tdesktop drops after kMaxDelay).
fix: Stamp EmojiEffect with its arrival time in the session and drop it in take_pending/advance_effects when older than START_WAIT.

title: 'Watching animation' action sends the emoji of the first effect in the chat, not the one that started
trigger: Two effects in one chat (a Premium sticker effect or an older emoji effect still playing), then the partner's emoji effect starts
effect: find(|a| a.effect.chat_id == chat_id) returns the first Active of that chat, so message_emoji reads another message and the partner is told you watch the wrong emoji
fix: Carry the started effect (or its head id) in watched instead of (ChatId, String) and look it up by head.

title: Word emoji bar stays expanded after it is closed by typing
trigger: Hover a lit word, click the chevron to open the grid, keep typing so the word is no longer highlighted (sync_emoji_words unhovers), then hover another lit word
effect: Only settle_word_bar(Close), Esc and pick call bar.reset(); the sync, block and turn-off paths unhover without it, so the next word bar opens already expanded and scrolled
fix: Make closing the word bar one function (unhover) that also resets the shared EmojiBarUi, or give each bar its own EmojiBarUi.

title: edr_on is lost with the replaced OnScreen, leaving the main window's layer in extended range
trigger: Open an HDR picture in the main window's viewer, then switch accounts (OnScreen is replaced whole, including a fresh HdrViewer with edr_on = false).
effect: want (false) equals the new edr_on (false) so set_window_edr(window, false) is never called; the CAMetalLayer stays a float extended-range drawable until another HDR picture is opened and closed (extra GPU memory and a different colour pipeline for the whole window).
fix: Keep the window's EDR mode in the WindowSlot / main window state (not in the per-account viewer), or have the Farewell of the viewer force set_window_edr(false).

title: A failed decode is cached as Loaded(Err) and never retried while the entry stays under budget
trigger: A picture whose file is partial or replaced in place at the same path fails to decode once (or a file is rewritten with new content).
effect: The tile stays blank (or shows the old decode) until the entry is evicted, which can be never when the cache is under budget.
fix: Key the entry by (path, mtime/len) and drop Err entries after a short life or on file-ready updates.

title: A sweep that finds a window mid-draw returns without rearming
trigger: A chat window is being drawn when the sweeper task runs after a retirement.
effect: Retired images wait in the atlas until some later wake (next retirement or chat frame); with nothing else drawing, they stay.
fix: On the early return, leave a pending-sweep marker that the next frame start or a short deferred wake handles.

title: Reaction and status selectors force tab = Emoji without syncing the GIF gate
trigger: Open the composer panel on the GIFs tab, then open the reaction selector from a message or the status selector from the main menu without closing the panel first.
effect: tab is set to Emoji directly, so shows_gifs() becomes false but sync_gif_downloads is not called; the session GIF gate (gifs.open) stays open and GIF downloads continue until some later close.
fix: Make selector modes carry their tab (PanelMode::Compose(PanelTab) vs selectors without one) and have set_media_panel_mode be the one place that syncs the GIF gate.

title: Album pin label clones the whole loaded history on every viewer chrome render
trigger: Open a photo that is part of an album in a chat with a long loaded history and where you can pin; play a video in an album or leave the zoom animating.
effect: viewer_chrome runs on every chrome redraw (up to every 100 ms while a clip plays) and each time collects h.ordered().cloned() for the whole history just to compute a label, so UI-thread work grows with history length.
fix: Compute album membership and pin state from the album's ids (a lookup by media_album_id) instead of cloning the history, or cache the label per item and session revision.
